ValidationRule.description: Coupon distributed date, distributed department, agent ID and distributed to agent date is required when the status is updated to Distributed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL(Coupon_Status__c, "Distributed") && ( ISBLANK( Coupon_Distributed_Date__c ) || ISBLANK(TEXT(Distribution_Department__c)) || ISBLANK( Distributed_Agent__c ) || ISBLANK( Coupon_Distributed_to_Agent_Date__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter the Coupon Distributed Date, Distributed Department, Agent ID and Distributed to Agent Date.
